svg.title: OpenRC Architecture & Feasibility Oracle Workflow
svg.desc: Vertical architectural workflow of OpenRC: Stage I (Case and POC Axes, covering curated built-in cases 9bus, 9bus-scaled, cigre-hv and primary tested pandapower cases pp:case33bw, pp:mv_oberrhein feeder=1, pp:create_cigre_network_mv, pp:case9, plus all 60 pandapower grids) feeds Stage II (Feasibility Oracle, a power-flow feasibility interface supporting LinDistFlow, SOCP, Exact Gurobi, and AC/DC OPF models with three-valued verdicts: FEASIBLE, INFEASIBLE, INCONCLUSIVE). Through a decoupled query-verdict loop, Stage III (Region Builder) constructs Stage IV (Convex Polytope), which then branches into Stage V (Compression, Validation & Certification, and Downstream Linear Optimization Applications).
svg.text: OPENRC ARCHITECTURE · SECURITY REGION COMPUTATION LIBRARY
Decoupling Power-Flow Physics from Computational Geometry & Mathematical Programming

g.text: or all 60 built-in grids via pp:<name>
• SI / Grid Units: MW, Mvar, kV, kA
Base nodal injections (p₀, q₀), topology & voltage/thermal limits
“Given a full nodal power injection vector (P, Q) = (p₀, q₀) + B·Δ for region coordinate Δ ∈ ℝᵈ,
can the network accommodate it within all voltage [v_min, v_max] and thermal I_max limits?”
FOUR PLUGGABLE POWER-FLOW & OPTIMAL POWER-FLOW MODEL FAMILIES
Standalone lindistflow or paired 2×2 for inner approximations (no solver)
Fast outer-relaxation screening; certifies global infeasibility
Certifies feasibility via Banach fixed-point interval enclosures
No radiality requirement; supports meshed grids & generator re-dispatch
stays outside during growth & escalates in validation.
• Replaces power flow with A Δ ≤ b

svg.text: Builders only call oracle.feasible_at(axes, Δ) or verdict_at().
Analytic lindistflow, socp, exact, and acopf share the same
geometry, seeding, facet-selection, and ray-search implementations.
Numerical non-convergence returns INCONCLUSIVE rather than a false
infeasibility claim. Growth conservatively excludes undecided points;
validation escalates them through socp screening and exact global solves.
